claims: All eight Ivy League schools are Brown, Columbia, Cornell, Dartmouth, Harvard, Penn, Princeton, and Yale.
All eight Ivy League schools simultaneously release their regular decision admission results for first-year applicants on Ivy Day 2026.
Decisions are typically released online at 7 p.m. ET.
Traditional "Ivy Day" ceremonies particularly at Penn involve ceremonies where graduating classes place ivy stones on campus buildings.
Ivy League colleges release results near the end of March rather than a single coordinated date every year.
